# A Chef-driven dining experience in the heart of Puerto Vallarta

**El Rey Bar & Supper Club** features outstanding fare and craft cocktails in a speakeasy atmosphere and patio poolside garden,

## A truly unique dining experience for creative food and drink

* * *

![Image 3](https://img1.wsimg.com/isteam/ip/79cd93cf-135c-4e72-b25f-ad7374a0f5c3/IMG_3399.jpeg/:/cr=t:0%25,l:0%25,w:100%25,h:100%25/rs=w:400,cg:true)

El Rey Bar & Supper Club is your home for creative food, a lively atmosphere, and fun in the A/C, featuring the best selection of local Mexican spirits! Enjoy award-winning creative comfort food, delicious poolside botanas, cocktails, beer, and wine — all served by a friendly staff with excellent service and a daily happy hour.

One of the largest Agave selections in Puerto Vallarta offering private [Tequila Tastings](https://elreybarpv.com/tequila-tastings)at your request.

[Book a Tequila Tasting Now](https://elreybarpv.com/book-now)

#### Our Story

Our Bar & Supper Club caters to diverse crowds, including locals and tourists, and is a local hotspot to enjoy great food and drinks, and the best in hospitality.

Vibrant atmosphere

Impressive drink menu

Exceptional Chef’s Menu

Poolside Garden Patio

A/C
